gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-tiktok-sans: Roomy-looking and a bit regal, Metamorphous sets its letters apart with generous sidebearings and softly shifting strokes above TikTok Sans. That body font's tall lowercase is its best trick.
gen-gf-offside-gf-sono: Commanding in its stance, Offside spaces its letters wide and leaves its curves unclosed, one level beat from start to finish. Sono follows with tall lowercase and generous spacing, so paragraphs stretch out easily.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-vend-sans: Oxanium comes in with big lowercase and unbroken single-line strokes. Vend Sans matches that largeness with ruler-straight lines and curves left open, which is the glue holding the pair together.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-stack-sans-notch: Paprika scatters its letters apart, with lowercase that fills the line much like capitals do. And Stack Sans Notch gives a long block of text open curves and rod-stock strokes, with a hefty feel in every word.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-stack-sans-text: Wide, loose and a little swaggering, Revalia strides across the line with an open-tailed g and tall letters. But Stack Sans Text meets it with a marker-like constant line and big-bodied lowercase, so the two sit comfortably together.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-sulphur-point: Stencil bridges cut right through Snowburst One, and its wide openings make the tall lowercase feel carved from a sheet. Sulphur Point goes the other way, with dowel-like stems and bent-dowel arcs that read smoothly in sans-serif form.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-yaldevi: Distinctive, pipe-cleaner strokes mark Tektur, whose curves all open generously. Yaldevi is the quieter one, a sans-serif whose e opens clearly to the right and keeps text easy to follow.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-ubuntu-sans: Tube-bright and loud, with a splayed c and short ascenders. Ubuntu Sans keeps the same large lowercase and pipe-like strokes in a plain sans, so the two feel cut from the same metal.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-sintony: Expressive and hand-lettered in feel, Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders low and its stroke weight level, with terminals pointing outward. Make it small and that low hum would fade quickly next to Sintony.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Unica One draws a very large lowercase with visible daylight in every curve, all at a single thickness. Schibsted Grotesk sits beside it with tall-bowled e and a shapes, and the two feel friendly and confident together.
